subject.title: Feature: allow account switching from /models buttons for GPT and Claude

question: Should `/models` grow a first-class auth-profile/account selector, and what cross-channel UX and persistence semantics should it use?
rationale: The source shows the lower-level auth-profile pinning exists, but exposing it in `/models` changes provider/account UX and session compatibility across Telegram, Discord, and shared command data.

options.title: Design shared account selector
options.body: Add a shared picker contract for compatible auth profiles, active-account display, and persistence, then implement it consistently across the supported channel pickers.

options.title: Land preservation only first
options.body: Continue treating https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92254 as the near-term bug fix and leave first-class picker account switching for a later product decision.

options.title: Keep typed profile pinning only
options.body: Do not add account switching to `/models`; keep `/model ...@<profileId>` and docs as the supported advanced path.

recommendation.title: Design shared account selector
recommendation.body: Add a shared picker contract for compatible auth profiles, active-account display, and persistence, then implement it consistently across the supported channel pickers.

likelyOwner.reason: History shows adjacent provider identity and session-helper work, and this decision crosses provider/auth/session UX boundaries.
